turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, am I speaking with Mrs. Banerjee from Bengaluru?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Rohan from the RBI compliance wing. We are calling because your bank KYC has expired and your account will be frozen by tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? I did not get any letter. My account is working fine today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The system is flagging it now, ma'am. If you have more than one lakh rupees in there, you might lose access to the funds temporarily.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh my goodness, I cannot have that. What do I need to do to fix this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can help you update it right now over the phone so you do not have to visit the branch. May I have your Aadhaar number first?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is this safe? Should I call my manager at the bank instead?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, the bank manager is busy. Just give me the Aadhaar and the OTP that is coming to your phone now to verify your identity.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am not sure about the OTP. Let me talk to my son first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you wait for your son, the window will close and the account will be blocked. Just read me the six digits quickly.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, please hold on a minute. I am getting very confused.
